ceiling_strength.definition: within-position weekly percentile of provider ceiling

floor_strength.definition: within-position weekly percentile of provider floor

overall_score.reason: V1 keeps floor, ceiling, and width conceptually separate.

volatility_width.direction: higher means wider provider outcome band
volatility_width.interpretation: dispersion context only; never synonymous with risk, quality, or expected points
volatility_width.normalization: within-position weekly percentile of positive width

phase_plan.name: private source/schema feasibility
phase_plan.purpose: verify explicit weekly floor/ceiling fields, coverage, scoring lens, source timestamp, and non-public licensing path

phase_plan.name: source semantics and validation preregistration
phase_plan.purpose: freeze provider field meanings, documented probability/quantile semantics if any, and exact Phase 2 validation gates before outcomes

phase_plan.name: retrospective validation
phase_plan.purpose: test only the validation metrics frozen in Phase 1B

phase_plan.name: prospective shadow
phase_plan.purpose: collect untouched future weekly snapshots before kickoff under frozen rules

phase_plan.name: display-only production consideration
phase_plan.purpose: consider non-FV display only for constructs that independently pass required gates

prohibited_transformations_before_source: combine floor strength and ceiling strength into one score
convert width into a penalty or bonus
infer quantile probabilities not explicitly documented by the provider
derive floor/ceiling from current FV, market value, ADP, or projection residuals
choose position-specific thresholds after viewing outcomes
scientific_notes: A provider band can be useful display context even if its literal nominal coverage is undocumented; however, no coverage claim may be made until semantics are frozen.
Volatility width is a descriptive provider-band property, not an independently validated player-risk construct.
Any later raw point display requires stronger validation than percentile/band display.
Failure of one construct does not automatically invalidate the other two; production consideration is construct-specific.

scope.player_identity_unit: player x NFL week x source snapshot

source_contract.required_input_type: explicit player-level weekly floor and ceiling fields
